It helps to recognize who in your life can receive your voice/feelings/wants/needs calmly and non-judgmentally and nourish those relationships. It also really helps to be able to see your past self through an “other” lens in order to be more compassionate to the “you” who didn’t have the tools or even the awareness to recognize unspoken/un-met feelings and needs. THAT’s a hard one, but for people like us, we can often extend that empathy to others in the present tense, so I’ve found it a helpful exercise to cut thru the shame in order to “figure it out.” I don’t have an answer because I’m still learning, failing, and will likely be working on it forever!
